Published examples show agents can replace implementations but do not establish that repeated regeneration is safe or economical (one is a one-time migration, the other one module). Open: what counts as continuity; what knowledge must persist (undocumented safeguards lost); whether maintenance effort shifts to the artefacts (precise specs 'start looking suspiciously like code'); risk of the same tests guiding and approving regeneration. Proposed evidence: case studies, agent traces, experiments varying the artefacts available during regeneration
